## What this letter says
Noah was seen in the Children's Emergency Department on 26 September 2026.

His temperature was 38.5°C when he was seen.

He has a viral infection.

Antibiotics are not needed.

## What you need to do
1. See your GP (family doctor) if Noah is not better in 5 days.

## Dates and medicines
- 26 September 2026: Noah was seen in the Children's Emergency Department.
- Medicines: the letter lists no medicines.

- What does "viral infection" mean?
- Why are antibiotics not needed for Noah?
- How will I know if Noah is not better?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
